article.headline: Graham scores 37 as Alabama A&M downs Lipscomb 85-69
article.description: — James Graham’s 37 points led Alabama A&M over Lipscomb 85-69 on Friday.
article.linkText: Graham scores 37 as Alabama A&M downs Lipscomb 85-69
article.story: HUNTSVILLE, Ala. -- — James Graham’s 37 points led Alabama A&M over Lipscomb 85-69 on Friday. Graham shot 13 for 15 (6 for 7 from 3-point range) and 5 of 6 from the free-throw line for the Bulldogs (4-2). Devontes Cobbs scored 16 points while going 7 of 13 (2 for 6 from 3-point range). Sami Pissis shot 4 of 8 from the field and 4 of 4 from the free-throw line to finish with 13 points. Titas Sargiunas led the way for the Bisons (3-4) with 13 points. Lipscomb also got 11 points and two blocks from Sawyer Dotson. Mateo Esmeraldo also had 10 points, six assists and three steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
